notes: Strip a: x 0-3080 plus overlap to ~3400. The plate's west edge is the west line of Reading Road (70 ft printed), which runs NE-SW diagonally from the top to y~4400, curves, then runs SSW to the plate bottom; Reading crossings are taken on the midline between the plate edge and the east street line (the double streetcar track runs 0-15 px west of that midline). Six partly cut street stubs protrude west of Reading on small plate tabs: 'AVE.' (Dana, aligned), '...LL AVE.' and '...SPRINGS' (a five-way junction at y~2300), '...AVE.' south of Burton, '...T AVE.' by Crescent, '...N AVE.' at y~5260; names not completed (not guessed). No suffix printed in this strip for Marion or Redway. Glenwood Avenue is one continuous street from Reading Road: E-W, then a zigzag (SE, E, NE, E) and SSE/S to a dead end at y~6292; its sections are labelled 'GLENWOOD', 'AVE' and 'GLENWOOD AVE'. A 10 ft unnamed walk/alley runs N-S at x~1105 from Glenwood to Mann Place (in alleys). Not streets: Cincinnati Northwestern R.R., green/pink/blue/yellow boundary bands, estate names (O. Taylor's, Dayton's Estate, Rose Hill, Lenox Park), German Prot. Cemetery, the 30 ft dead-end strip ESE of the Glenwood SSE turn at (3300-3475,5630-5755) (no name, closed by a 30' line), and dashed sewer/proposed lines in the City of Cincinnati land. Victory Boulevard (printed 'VICTORY' ... 'BLVD.') crosses the strip's SE corner at x 3170-3380, y 6520-6760 with no crossings; only part of its width is on the plate there, so no end recorded.
